posts.title: Traditional Burial Grounds Emptied in Wake of DPRK Policies
posts.description: North Korea's hillsides host countless burial mounds in clusters ranging from just a few burials to many thousands. These irregular cemeteries have been a common feature of mourning and remembrance for generations.
